text.p: Here are the main headlines from the afternoon report of Lithuania's M1 Plus radio station. Reuters has not confirmed these reports and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Government Reform and Municipal Affairs Ministry Secretary Laima Skeberdiene was killed by her husband, who has confessed to the killing. The cause of death was not given.
- Lithuania's peacekeeping platoon, LITPLA-5, is headed back to Bosnia after a July vacation. The platoon has been stationed in Bosnia since April.

- The criminal case against former Lietuvos Aidas chief editor Saulius Stoma was expected to restart on Tuesday. Stoma is alleged to have embezzled more than 600,000 litas from the right-leaning newspaper and of falsifying documents.
